title: Cloud accounts
intro: Manufacturer accounts · multiple manufacturers and accounts per manufacturer.
certificatesIntro: One server-wide set, independent of cloud accounts.
expiring: Expiry is near or past: check renewal status.
certificatesNote: Encrypted local storage. PEM format only; the printer decides acceptance. Import does not trigger any command.
bambuNote: Bambu Lab: devices added from an account use signed cloud commands with the imported PEMs. Camera and files are discovered automatically on the local network.
providerPlanned: Account saved; cloud connector not yet integrated for this manufacturer.
noDevices: No devices returned by this account.
truncated: Display limited to the first 200 devices received.
noAccounts: No cloud accounts. Add your first manufacturer account.
logNote: Last 300 lines · passwords, codes, tokens and cookies excluded.
deleteText: Delete “{name}”, its connection and local logs? Linked devices must be removed from the fleet first.
removeText: Remove “{name}” from FabCore? It will remain linked to your manufacturer account.
codeEmail: Enter the code received by email.
codeApp: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
passwordNote: Account created with Google, Apple or Facebook? In Bambu Handy: Profile → Account Security → Change Password. Use that Bambu password here, never your Google password.
passwordSent: Sent to Bambu over HTTPS; not retained by FabCore.
importNote: Three PEM files required. The private key is stored encrypted, never displayed or returned by the server. No control enabled.
refreshUrlNote: This URL enables automatic PEM renewal before expiry. It remains secret.
renewalNote: This URL is secret and will never be displayed again. A blank field disables automatic renewal.

errors.bambu-cert-refresh-failed: Renewal failed. Previous PEMs are preserved; check the URL or import files again.
errors.bambu-cert-refresh-url: Invalid refresh URL: use the complete Bambu HTTPS URL containing /applications/, or leave blank.
errors.bambu-cert-crl-format: crl.pem: X509 CRL PEM block required.
errors.bambu-cert-key-format: key.pem: private key PEM block required.
errors.bambu-cert-invalid: Invalid PEM files: check the key and certificates (48 KiB maximum each).
errors.cloud-machine-exists: This device is already in FabCore, via LAN or cloud.
errors.cloud-in-use: Remove linked fleet devices before deleting this account.
errors.cloud-auth: Sign-in denied or expired. Reconnect this account.
errors.cloud-access: Bambu denied this access (HTTP 403). Check the account log.
errors.cloud-unavailable: Bambu is unreachable or the connection timed out.
errors.cloud-response: Unrecognized Bambu response. Check the log.
errors.cloud-challenge: Bambu portal verification is unavailable. No automatic bypass.
errors.cloud-rate: Bambu rate limit reached. Wait before retrying.
errors.cloud-login-wait: Wait one minute before restarting sign-in. You can enter the code already received.
errors.cloud-busy: An operation is already running for this account.
errors.cloud-storage: Account or log storage unavailable. Check permissions and the encryption key.
errors.cloud-invalid: Check name, manufacturer, region and email.
errors.cloud-unsupported: This manufacturer connection is not integrated yet.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Wait a moment.
errors.command-busy: A command is running on this machine.
